definitions.title: Area of a Planar Region via Double Integration
definitions.statement: The area of a closed, bounded plane region R is the double integral of the constant function f(x, y) = 1 over R.
conditions: R is a Jordan-measurable bounded region in R^2
definitions.explanation: Setting height z = 1 produces a solid cylinder whose numerical volume equals the numerical area of the base.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Unifies single-variable area formulas into a single conceptual framework.

definitions.title: Average Value over General Planar Regions
definitions.statement: The mean or average value of a continuous function f over region R is the ratio of its total double integral to the area of R.
definitions.explanation: Represents the constant uniform height of a prism over R that has the identical volume as the solid under z = f(x, y).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Computes spatial averages across non-rectangular geometric domains.
